name: Ore no Onshi wa Kuso Bitch
source:
The school was famous for its beautiful teachers. His friend, who went elsewhere, was jealous. Of course, he told that friend there was nothing to be jealous about. They were teachers, and they were perfect flowers. Way out of everyone's league. Unattainable.

That's what he told his friend, but to himself, he'd made a vow: to screw that one teacher he yearned for most of all, even if he had to take her by force. Of course, he seemed hopeless... until suddenly another teacher invited him to a midnight hotel rendezvous. Timid as a mouse he met the gorgeous woman. Seeing her at night, outside of class, was disorienting. She oozed sensuality like a harlot, and like a harlot, she embraced him and blew his mind. It was the sexiest revelation of his life.

"My teacher... is such a... freaking nymphomaniac...!"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE153650.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这所学校因拥有美丽的女教师而闻名。转学到别处的朋友对此羡慕不已。当然，他告诉朋友没什么好羡慕的：她们只是老师，是完美的花朵，所有人都高攀不起。

这是他对朋友说的话，可在心里，他早已发誓：即使必须用强迫的方式，也要和自己最渴望的那位老师上床。当然，他看起来毫无希望……直到某天，另一位老师邀请他午夜在酒店见面。

他像胆小的老鼠一样前去赴约。夜晚、教室之外的她让他感到眩晕。她像妓女一样散发着淫荡气息，也像妓女一样拥抱他，让他彻底沉沦。这是他人生中最性感的启示。

“我的老师……竟然是……该死的性欲狂……！”
